name: armasu-route-release
description: Sort Armasu page routes by who can reach them and whether they are finished, to decide which may appear in public screenshots

audience.instructions: Who reaches this page in normal use? Read `linked_from`, `admin_checks` and `signed_out_allowed` first, then `source`.

criteria.any_signed_in_user: Some file in `linked_from` is ordinary navigation (sidebar, footer, profile tabs, a page button) and `admin_checks` is none or only hides extra controls inside the page
criteria.admin_only: The page itself refuses non admins: `admin_checks` names isAdminEmail, showFotdPopup or an /api/admin route that the page depends on to render anything
criteria.signed_out_visitor: `signed_out_allowed` is yes and the page is a sign in, access gate or phone pairing screen
criteria.unreachable: `linked_from` says nothing links here, or the only links are from admin pages or from files that are not navigation

finished.instructions: Does `source` render a working feature built on the signed in user's real data or real API calls, rather than a coming soon notice, hard coded example arrays, or a developer test harness?

fake_data.instructions: Does `source` show hard coded sample content (example notifications, example outfits, made up follower counts, placeholder emoji) as if it were real?
